description: Adds an article (SOP) to the handbook, as Handbook > Admin > New SOP does: title, content_md (markdown), optional category, tags, audience (cleaner = staff, va = office), bucket (A, B or C), licensed (from a franchise or licensed manual: never shared outside the business). Nothing is sent. Before adding anything to the handbook, search the sops read entity by the topic (search finds by meaning): when an article already covers it, put the new text into that article (edit_handbook_article with its full content_md, the new lines placed where they belong, or draft_handbook_edit) instead of a new one; create a new article only when none fits, and say which closest article you found and why it did not fit. Audience comes from the person's words: cleaner SOPs, cleaning standards or staff = cleaner; policies, office or VA = va; when the words do not say, ask in one line. Ask which place, in one line naming both, when two places fit the person's words equally well: two articles, or two training modules that both match (two new-hire modules are a tie whatever their status, draft or published); a place the person named outright is never a tie. The proposed change is the confirmation, so never ask "should I add this?" first. A new article meant for training (new-hire training, onboarding) is also added to that training module's atom_order with edit_training_module, set to run after this. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the same article.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: create_handbook_article
title: Add a handbook article
